content: Bear notes uses inline #hashtags anywhere in text (multi-word tags via #Some Words#), supports infinite nested tags via slash (#food/french), and a sidebar tag browser. Search supports phrase quoting, exclusion via hyphen, special @-prefixed searches (@task, @todo), and nested-tag wildcard queries (#*/coffee/medium roast#). Tag matching is exact-string; no typo tolerance or auto-merging of near-duplicate tags.
